text: かだんに　やせいの　ポケモンが　はいらない　ように　むしよけスプレー　まいてるのさ

structure.jp: かだんに　やせいの　ポケモンが　はいらない　ように
structure.en: so that wild Pokémon don't get into the flower bed

structure.jp: むしよけスプレー　まいてるのさ

patterns.name: 〜ように
patterns.span: はいらない　ように
patterns.explanation: ように after a verb says 'so that' this will be the result. はいらない　ように = 'so that they don't get in'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now; てる is the casual short form. まいてる = 'am spraying'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives the sentence an explaining tone, as if answering 'what are you doing?'. さ is a breezy, casual ending used here in place of だ. まいてるのさ = 'I'm spraying, you see'.
